statutory_dues.text:
According to the information and explanations given to me and on the basis of my examination of the records of the Company:
 
 
 
 
According to the books and records of the company produced to me, the Company is regular in depositing with the appropriate authorities undisputed statutory dues including provident fund, employee’s state insurance, income tax, wealth tax, sales tax, value added tax, GST, custom duty, excise duty, cess and other statutory dues as applicable. According to the information and explanations given to me and upon my enquiries in this regard, no undisputed amounts payable in respect of Income Tax, Wealth Tax, Sales Tax, Value Added Tax, GST, customs duty and excise duty were outstanding as at March 31, 2025 for a period of more than six months from the date they became payable.
